cohort: The study included 183 neonates (>= 34 weeks' gestation) with transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) who received initial respiratory support with either NIV-NAVA or SiPAP.
finding: NIV-NAVA demonstrated a significantly lower rate of treatment failure and a shorter duration of oxygen therapy compared to SiPAP, with comparable intubation rates, for managing TTN in late preterm and term neonates.
